name: Gridhopping
definition: A method for transforming a Signed Distance Bound (SDB) into a polygon mesh by combining sphere tracing (ray marching) with traditional polygonization techniques like Marching Cubes. It efficiently isolates the O(N^2) cells containing the surface of a shape within an N^3 grid, achieving O(N^2 log N) complexity.
summary: Gridhopping transforms Signed Distance Bounds into polygon meshes by using sphere tracing to skip empty space, making it faster than standard enumeration.
